title: Finite scalar-extension composition factor
statement: Fix the setting of the ramified module comparison, a scheme morphism g:X→Y, e,j, source Coefficients on Y and a level n. Extension along the finite coefficient map j_X of g*_E(reduce_E M) is isomorphic, for every completed E-module M on Y, to g*_L(reduce_L(extend_source M)). The forward map sends c tensor (b·g*_E(a tensor p)) to (c·j_X(b))·g*_L(j_Y(a) tensor (1 tensor p)). There is no completed coefficient map or coefficient isomorphism on X in this statement. The pure tensors and pullback generators are the existing normalized scalar, reduction and pullback adjunction units.

proof.text: The source ramified_projection square identifies the composites of the two scalar restrictions. Compose the reduction and scalar adjunctions along either path and use uniqueness of left adjoints to obtain reductionSquareIso. Its unit equation sends 1 tensor (1 tensor p) to 1 tensor (1 tensor p). Linearity gives the formula with arbitrary inner finite coefficient a.

proof.text: The finite constant-coefficient square commutes by naturality of the canonical constant-section direct ring map in j. The two composites of restriction and module direct image are therefore isomorphic, with identity action on underlying sections. Compose their scalar and geometric pullback adjunctions and use uniqueness of left adjoints to obtain finitePullbackSquareIso, normalized by its composite-unit equation.

proof.text: Compose finitePullbackSquareIso with geometric pullback of reductionSquareIso. Naturality of the pullback unit proves the generator formula for outer coefficients 1,1. Source balancing and target linearity of the scalar tensor, then linearity of the composite, yield the formula for arbitrary b and c. This entire argument is implemented in Lean without new holes.

mathlib_searches.query: For sheaves of modules over a commutative square of ring sheaves, if the coefficient tensor map is an isomorphism then scalar extension commutes with restriction of scalars for every module.

Cancellation identifies sheaf tensors; tensorPushoutAction requires sectionwise ring tensor isomorphisms, whereas Coefficients supplies a sheafified module isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarComposition_exists {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (e : ℕ)
    (j : ∀ n : ℕ, Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1) →+*
      Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (index e n + 1))
    (source : Coefficients l E L ι e j Y) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ d : ∀ M : integralTowerModules l E Y,
      (scalar.{t, u} (ramifiedMap l E L X e n (j n))).obj
          ((integralOperationsLevelPullback l E g n).obj
            ((unrestrictedIntegralReductionFunctor l E Y n).obj M)) ≅
        (integralOperationsLevelPullback l L g (index e n)).obj
          ((unrestrictedIntegralReductionFunctor l L Y (index e n)).obj
            ((scalar.{t, u} source.completedMap).obj M)),
      ∀ (M : integralTowerModules l E Y) (V : Y.ProEt)
        (a : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n).obj.obj (op V))
        (b : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n).obj.obj
          (op ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V)))
        (c : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l L X (index e n)).obj.obj
          (op ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))) (p : M.val.obj (op V)),
        (d M).hom.val.app _
          (tensor.{t, u} (ramifiedMap l E L X e n (j n)) _ _ c
            (b • @id (((integralOperationsLevelPullback l E g n).obj
              ((unrestrictedIntegralReductionFunctor l E Y n).obj M)).val.obj
                (op ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V)))
              (integralOperationsPullbackGenerator l E g n _ V
                (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E Y n M (op V) a p)))) =
          (c * (ramifiedMap l E L X e n (j n)).hom.app _ b) •
            @id (((integralOperationsLevelPullback l L g (index e n)).obj
              ((unrestrictedIntegralReductionFunctor l L Y (index e n)).obj
                ((scalar.{t, u} source.completedMap).obj M))).val.obj
                  (op ((Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V)))
              (integralOperationsPullbackGenerator l L g (index e n) _ V
                (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l L Y (index e n)
                  ((scalar.{t, u} source.completedMap).obj M) (op V)
                  ((ramifiedMap l E L Y e n (j n)).hom.app (op V) a)
                  (tensor.{t, u} source.completedMap M (op V) 1 p)))
